budget_items.topic: Electricity and natural gas rate increase
budget_items.what_was_recorded: An upcoming electricity and natural gas rate increase, estimated at roughly 65%, was raised against an FY15 annual budgeted amount for energy; John Henshaw said the increase appears inflated and more detail is needed.

budget_items.topic: Changing inside lights to LEDs before grant money
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The cost of changing inside lights to LEDs now, before grant money is available, was asked; a cost/benefit analysis is needed. No dollar figure printed.
